groups.name:
No indication Home/Away Goal (No Onwards)
Filter by Accept Time
description: Provider missed or delayed Score show by more than one (1) minute.
=> Missed update Home/Away score -> But there is happened score awarded.
Att: Actual Goal compare last ticket trans.time base on 1 min to use message type.
Over 1 min consider wrong score/Missed > Goal 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:01:00.
Within 1mins consider danger accept Goal 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:00:20.
* Home Missed > Request Home. Away Missed > Request Away.

groups.name:
Wrong Indication Goal (No Onwards)
Filter by Trans Time
description: Provider wrong display Home/Away Score and/or in fact there is no Score awarded.
=> Wrong update Home/Away score -> But there is 'No Score' awarded.
Example: 0-0 to 0-1, Cancel Goal, all 0-1 need void all. Single team O/U home team score 0-0 accept after Goal valid.
We use transtime to void, TVS will auto detect wrong score range time.

groups.name: Wrong Indication Swap Team Score (No Onwards)<div class='text-danger'>Filter by Trans Time & Accept Time
description: Provider wrong display Swap Team Score.
=> Wrong update Away Score -> Correct there is Home Score awarded. So Single team O/U home team admin will wrong accept.
Example: 0-0 to 0-1 wrong update, Correct is 1-0, need void all ticket. Single team O/U home team score 0-0 accept after Goal is wrong, need void all.

groups.name: Wrong Indication Swap Team Score (Onwards)<div class='text-danger'>Filter by Trans Time & Accept Time
description: Provider wrong display Swap Team Score.
=> Wrong update Away Score -> Correct there is Home Score awarded. So Single team O/U home team admin will wrong accept.
Example: 0-0 to 0-1 wrong update, Correct is 1-0, need void all ticket. Single team O/U home team score 0-0 accept after Goal is wrong, need void all.

groups.name: Next Goal
description: Goal: Select Subtype Next Goal, Message-Match completed
*Red Card, 2YC (Select Subtype same main match, use Message-Danger accept)

groups.name: Next Corner
description: *Possible Corner (Select Subtype Next Corner, use Message-Match completed)
*Ball out the end line (Select Subtype Next Corner, use Message-Match completed)
*Not use for Red Card, 2YC (Select Subtype same main match #4, use Message-Danger accept)

groups.name: Next Booking
description: All Subtypes use Next Booking, Message-Match completed:
*Provider show YC/RC
*Referee judge YC/RC (Follow booking time)
*Foul > VAR > YC/RC (Follow foul time)

groups.name: Next Goal Kick
description: *Goal Kick (Select Subtype Next Goal Kick, use Message-Match completed)
*Ball out the end line (Select Subtype Next Goal Kick, use Message-Match completed)
*Not use for Red Card, 2YC (Select Subtype same main match #4, use Message-Danger accept)
